title: Prove sandbox adoption end-to-end through the real Go executor and the real door, not a restated fixture
body: internal/reconcile/sandbox_adoption_test.go proves avx's acceptance through a fixture executor that restates the door's semantics, because reconcile may not import cloudflaresandbox and the production factory cannot build that executor. Once the executor is wired, a test (or a recorded cloud run) should kill and re-derive an orchestrator whose dispatch goes through cloudflaresandbox.Executor against the door (or its TS test double over HTTP), so the adoption guarantee covers the code that will actually run.
